service: form a source-custodied research packet from separately contracted current evidence and bounded prior-research recovery
admission: ActivityStreams Offer<ServiceSolicitation> addressed to the provider, followed by Accept<ServiceContract> carrying the exact provider offer
preconditions: the demand names one publication-owned assignment, exact freshness and evidence budgets, exact customer-declared primary-source URLs, and the customer source-policy digest
current evidence is an accepted Newscable delivery whose digest binds every returned immutable bundle
prior research is an accepted Corpus Management result whose digests bind its contextual and gap bundles
the customer accepts the zero-price offer and its exact demand digest
postconditions: the provider returns a research packet containing fresh relevant current-source claims and digest-bound prior-research context, or a typed refusal
prior-corpus excerpts remain context-only and never become public factual claims without separate current-source admission
the packet binds its current-source and prior-research custody evidence without reading or writing either customer's or provider's territory
the demand and search terms remain attention pressure rather than evidence
the customer independently admits or refuses the packet and retains all assignment, corpus, editorial, publication, and delivery authority
